text: Ironically, I'm using Google Voice to leave this review, because the free version of Wispr Flow cuts you off after only a small number of words for the day or week. It's a shame, because this is a 5 star program. But limiting the free version this much leaves a bad impression on many people, and at $12 a month the paid plan feels overpriced to me. A more generous free tier or a cheaper plan would make this an easy recommendation.
